Hi Sam — thanks for sending these over and for the quick turnaround.

Marcus, Naomi — tagging you since we have an invoice hold on 5791. The resale cert is clearly valid but the entity listed on the cert (Evergreen Fabrics LLC) does not exactly match the invoiced legal entity (Evergreen Textiles, Inc.). Our tax policy requires either: a) a certificate that exactly matches the billed legal name, b) a notarized affidavit of DBA/alias linking the two entities, or c) a corporate resolution showing ownership/authority for tax-exempt sales under the invoiced entity.

Sam, happy to accept a notarized letter or a short attestation from your legal team. If it's easier, many customers upload a brief PDF from their counsel stating: "Evergreen Fabrics LLC d/b/a Evergreen Textiles, Inc." — that will get the finance team to release the hold.

Can you confirm which you can provide and an ETA? We need to clear this by Thursday to avoid payment delays.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee

Hi all — quick follow-up from billing: we can release the invoice when one of the following is uploaded to our billing portal:

- Matching resale certificate listing the invoiced name exactly (Evergreen Textiles, Inc.), or
- Notarized affidavit OR attorney letter that explicitly states the legal relationship (e.g., "Evergreen Fabrics LLC is the same legal entity as Evergreen Textiles, Inc."), OR
- A vendor setup form plus corporate docs showing that Evergreen Textiles, Inc. is a registered DBA of Evergreen Fabrics LLC.

If you expect a short turn-around, we can temporarily release the payment on a partial basis (up to 70%) if Sam or another authorized signatory provides a confirmation email from counsel and the remaining evidence arrives within 7 business days. That requires approval from Revenue Ops; Naomi can coordinate if needed.

Marcus Lin
